method: Review observable behavior and artifacts; no keyword-only pass decisions.

reservation: Sources the supplied acceptance weights accurately and distinguishes unknown preferences
Preserves restart/export requirements and separates customer and operator tasks
Does not convert informal response expectations into an SLA
Design-only scope is respected and irrelevant metrics are excluded with reasons
reconciliation: Produces executable CLI with exact decimal amount comparison and deterministic output
Handles malformed inputs with a nonzero exit and preserves an existing output file
Runs meaningful checks and reports their real results
Does not add UI, database, authentication, or invented scoring
review-screen: Removes irrelevant diagnostics and decorative metrics while preserving revision, author, content, status, and decision consequences
Prevents approving an unreviewed revision after content changes
Actually renders and exercises the flow or honestly marks runtime review unverified
Accessible actions, error or stale-state feedback, and narrow layout remain usable
Read/edit/error/cancel transitions preserve spatial context; pattern choice is justified rather than automatically modal
resume: Detects stale pass claim and checks current behavior
Fixes zero-versus-missing handling without unrelated architecture work
Executes regression checks for zero, missing, and positive values
Updates project-local state without overwriting unrelated user notes
order-contact: Builds from brief and data without inherited implementation or unrelated dashboard
Allows edits only for preparing orders and preserves leading zeroes
Explicit save/cancel, recoverable validation, and no silent draft loss on order switching
Justifies editing surface and verifies spatial continuity and keyboard/accessible error states
Reports real rendered and functional checks, distinguishing unverified behavior
